bestBets.overview: Tricky race with three debutantes, watch market moves for the trio. THE OBVIOUS CHILD was placed in a jumpout here last month, then finished a close fourth in a 1000m Halidon trial last Thursday. He has drawn favourably in barrier 2. LEADING RIDE has placed in two recent jumpouts. There was money for SIDEBAR has a few gear changes and will strip fitter for one run back from a break. ANGRY BERDI took out a Naracoorte maiden on Friday. She's the only winner in the race but she gets no favours here at the weights.

raceTips.comment: The Obvious Child is on debut and was 4th in a recent Mindarie Halidon trial. Angry Berdi was well ridden to score at Naracoorte last Friday and draws the inside. Leading Ride debuts for the Bain/Taylor stable and won a Strathalbyn trial back in March and has had two jump-outs this time around.  Sidebar can improve here.

bestBets.overview: MAHALER has not been far away in the finish in two runs back from a spell. She'll strip fitter again and will find this easier. BLAZING RED has been runner-up at his past couple of outings. PROMPT INVOICE was runner-up in an 850m jumpout here on August 13th. He has drawn to get a good run from the inside gate and wears blinkers for the first time today. LARGS LEGACY was placed three times last campaign, all over longer trips. Expect to see her doing her best work late in the race. RED RIPPLES made some late ground to finish just behind the placegetters over 1200m when resuming.

raceTips.comment: Mahaler made good ground in 3rd behind Xitan at Strathalbyn before running 4th behind Torpedoes on the Parks. She’s ready to win. Largs Legacy has been placed at three of five the latest running 3rd behind Valued. She was 4th in a recent jump-out here. Blazing Red has been runner-up at his last two the latest behind Winning All Round at Strathalbyn. Prompt Invoice is on debut, ran 2nd in a recent jump-out here and wears blinkers from the inside. The market will be the best guide. Red Ripples had specking at odds when 4th behind Divergent here. Ullrich has shown ability. Deadset Magic was OK on debut. Canny Maid has been OK in a couple of jump-outs.

bestBets.overview: MIRALAND made good ground from back in the field to finish third this route last month. Blinkers go back on today and Noel Callow sticks with him. WINSTON'S PRIDE has placed at his past four outings. With the right run, he'll be around the mark again. LAST WEEKS PAY failed to beat a runner home in a strong 3yo race in town ten days ago. He has since been placed in a 1000m Halidon trial. DIDACTIC tired in the run to the line when rising quickly in distance at his second start. Blinkers go on for the first time today.  MANDARIN and OR AM I are others that could be worth including.

raceTips.comment: Last Weeks Pay jumped out well before running down the track behind the talented Pretty Baby on the Parks when there was market support. She has been placed in a trial since. Miraland was good in 3rd behind Terminal Shock here and gets the blinkers back on. Winston’s Pride has been placed at his past four the latest behind Extra Chill at Strathalbyn. He draws out. Mandarin has been placed at five of 12 the latest when 2nd behind Terminal Shock. Didactic was OK beaten in the Extra Chill race at Strathalbyn last time and gets blinkers for the first time.

bestBets.overview: Eight of the 16 acceptors are debutantes and another six are resuming. Market moves will be crucial. SNOBZ was sent out favourite this route on debut in February but he blew the start badly, and that was the end of his chances. He has won two jumpouts in recent weeks. BUFFO was found to have a slow recovery rate after finishing fifth at Donald on debut in May. He was runner-up in a jumpout here on August 13th. Former Queenslander ATOMIC TIME has been racing well over longer trips this preparation. SCRIPTED LOVE, SEND IT AGAIN and TOTAL LOVE are amongst a host of other chances.

raceTips.comment: Atomic Time is first-up in SA and has been placed at seven of 12 starts in Queensland. The market will be the best guide to this race. Buffo ran 5th at Donald on debut in May and was 2nd in a recent jump-out here. Snobz was well beaten on debut back in Feb but has won recent jump-outs here and at Morphettville. Son Of Cocoa debuts and has shown ability in three jump-outs. Blue Moon Effect was 2nd in a recent jump-out here. Scripted Love and Waterloo Winner have also jumped-out OK.

bestBets.overview: GOODLOOKIN' GURU got the money this route two starts ago then went to Strathalbyn where she didn't run a strong 1600m. She can bounce back in this. TORRITA was placed in a stronger race at Morphettville two starts ago. She got too far out of her ground last time and never looked a winning hope. PLAY BOUZOUKI has been freshened since finishing midfield this track/trip last month. YARRAWIZARDHARRY is better than his first up effort suggests. MAGIC ISLAND was found to be lame after finishing down the track in town third-up. A firmer track here is in her favour. BLUE ISLES is becoming costly to follow but could be worth including in multiples.

raceTips.comment: Blue Isles was placed at Balaklava and Morphettville before running 4th behind Australia Forever on the Parks last time. Torrita was good running 3rd behind Jandami on the Parks two runs back and then 6th behind Petit Eagle here. Goodlookin’ Guru was a good winner here two runs back and then a drifter when 7th behind Spelman and Hamner Springs at Strathalbyn. Stylish Sparkle was well beaten in a Listed race and then 5th behind Orthie’s Boys at Mildura. She can improve here. Win To Retire is a former WA galloper. Play Bouzouki was a Donald maiden winner two runs back. Magic Island ran OK here two back. Yarrawizardharry won a Balaklava maiden in March and is fitter. Frontpoint is hard to catch but wasplaced here four runs back.

bestBets.overview: Backmarker DURHAM ran home well to finish a close second to Mangione at Warracknabeal last start. He won his maiden over 1600m here in July. Wet tracks have been against BIT OF A REBEL this time in work. He showed some improvement when fifth behind Hamner Springs third-up. The rise to 1800m is ideal. BELLE FROM HELL has been racing consistently and deserves to win another race soon. CHARTIN came away for a strong win over 2000m here three weeks ago. Back to 1800m won't worry him.
